purpose: Validate user-facing fertility, mortality and migration multipliers as explicit sensitivities separate from the production baseline.
requiredChecks: all controls at 1 reproduce the unadjusted production baseline
fertility multiplier 0 produces zero births while leaving source rates unchanged
mortality multiplier 0 produces zero deaths while leaving source risks unchanged
net-migration multiplier 0 produces zero net migration in production net mode
migration multiplier scales the net-migration contribution deterministically
sensitivity controls do not mutate model_data or production defaults
governance: Multipliers are sensitivity tools, not calibration knobs.
They must never be tuned to improve historical backtest outcomes.
